pages.quiz:
MUSIC AND DANCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: MUSIC AND DANCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Dance Production: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Dance Production.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Dance Production.
   C. Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Dance Production.

2. Best practice when working on Setting Text to Music: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Setting Text to Music.
   B. Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Setting Text to Music.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Setting Text to Music.

3. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the volume
   B. The speed of the music
   C. Only the costume
   D. The ticket price

4. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Red, blue, and yellow
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Black, white, and grey

5. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Songs.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Songs.
   C. Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Songs.

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Guarantee a trophy
   B. Replace drinking water
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Remove the need for rules

9. Best practice when working on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   B. Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.
   D. Damage equipment used for Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines;.

10. Best practice when working on Western Style Solo Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Western Style Solo Songs.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Western Style Solo Songs.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Western Style Solo Songs.

11. Best practice when working on Music Notation Software: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Music Notation Software.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Music Notation Software.
   C. Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Music Notation Software.

12. Best practice when working on Transposition: (1 mark)
   A. Damage equipment used for Transposition.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Transposition.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Transposition.
   D. Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software 1.7 Dance Production 2.0 Performing 2.1 Kenyan Folk Song and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Music Notation Software and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Dance Production and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

====

1. C — Practise Dance Production with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. B — Practise Setting Text to Music with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

3. B — The speed of the music

4. B — Red, blue, and yellow

5. A — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs 2.2 Western Style Solo Songs 2.3 Kenyan Indigenous Musical Ins with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. C — Practise Kenyan Folk Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

9. B — Practise Two-Part Harmony Two-part harmony guidelines; with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. A — Practise Western Style Solo Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

11. C — Practise Music Notation Software with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. D — Practise Transposition with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
